examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?
Here is a document from the prosecutor's office.

examples.text: Я тебе утром говорил: не торопись. Это очень важный вопрос.
examples.trans: I told you this morning: don't rush. It's a very important question.
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

meanings.note: Adds a reason or an obvious truth.

examples.trans: I did tell you, you know!

examples.text: Садись, не бойся. Я ведь сам чуть тебя не отпустил.
examples.trans: Sit down, don't be afraid. I very nearly let you go myself.

взрослый.gloss: adult, grown-up; (as a noun) a grown-up

meanings.note: as a noun, often plural: взрослые = grown-ups

examples.text: Маленькие умеют терпеть, а взрослые нет, понял?
examples.trans: Little ones can hold on, but grown-ups can't, got it?

meanings.note: Праздник вкуса = a feast of flavour.
Не в моём вкусе = not my type.

examples.text: Я бы рад вам помочь. Но вы, к сожалению, не в моём вкусе.
examples.trans: I would be glad to help you. But unfortunately you are not my type.
All right, here you go. There, look.
Seems not, we are not rushing.
There at the cemetery is the main entrance.
Where is the entrance to the metro?
We will open this entrance right now.

выпить.gloss: to drink (up); to have a drink

meanings.en: to drink up, to have a drink of

examples.trans: May I drink a tiny drop of beer?

examples.text: Милый, можно я выпью капельку пива?
examples.trans: Darling, may I drink a tiny drop of beer?

related.gloss: to go on a drinking binge

examples.text: Клавдия Викторовна, к вам гости! Па-пам!
examples.trans: Klavdia Viktorovna, you have visitors! Ta-da!

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
Any day now, on the website.

meanings.note: imperative держи! when handing something over

examples.trans: Here you go, this is for you.
All right, here you go. There, look.

договариваться.gloss: to agree, to make a deal

meanings.en: to agree, to have an agreement

examples.text: Как же так? Мы же с вами договаривались!
examples.trans: How can this be? We had an agreement!

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?
not to be confused with есть 'there is' (from быть)

examples.text: Я вчера ел маринованные грибы. Может, один гриб был плохой.
examples.trans: Yesterday I ate pickled mushrooms. Maybe one mushroom was bad.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.
There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

examples.text: На кухне картины Дали и Ван Гога.
examples.trans: Paintings by Dalí and Van Gogh in the kitchen.
Beautiful paintings hang in the museum.

examples.text: У вас очень плохая картина по безопасности.
examples.trans: You have a very bad picture regarding safety.

examples.text: Для вас можно открыть салон красоты.
examples.trans: We could open a beauty salon for you.

examples.text: Можно ещё кусочек? И шампанское можно выпить?
examples.trans: May I have another slice? And can I drink the champagne?
No, I am simply admiring you.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: Два года назад = two years ago.

examples.text: Я их ещё два года назад им выделил!
examples.trans: I allocated it to them two years ago!

examples.text: Я их ещё два года назад им выделил! Я сам приказ подписывал!
examples.trans: I allocated it to them two years ago! I signed the order myself!

найтись.gloss: to be found, to turn up

meanings.en: to be found, to turn up
meanings.note: When something lost is found again.

examples.trans: Be grateful the dog turned up.

examples.text: У нас для всех работа найдётся.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Ну что же, неплохо. Ты молодец.
examples.trans: Well then, not bad. Good job.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

examples.text: Она нашла нас на новом месте.
examples.trans: She found us at the new place.
That is it, she got really offended.
She is not answering her phone.

meanings.en: to give away, to hand over

examples.trans: He will hand over the money.

examples.text: Потом надо отдать москвичам твои деньги из подвала.
examples.trans: Then I have to give your money from the basement to the Moscow people.

examples.text: Квартира будет отличная. На Симашко есть новый дом.
examples.trans: It'll be an excellent flat. There's a new building on Simashko Street.
I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

examples.text: Это Аракелян. Я по поводу торгового центра.
examples.trans: It's Arakelyan. I'm calling about the shopping centre.

examples.text: Зачем вы повесили на него тяжёлый замок?
examples.trans: Why did you hang a heavy lock on it?

meanings.note: с + instrumental: with someone; + instrumental: something

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!
examples.trans: Wait, Nina, you don't get it. It's shameful!

порвать.gloss: to tear up; (slang) to blow away, break (the internet)

meanings.en: to blow away, smash, 'break the internet'

examples.text: Ты весь интернет порвал! Сосед твой — народный герой!
examples.trans: You broke the whole internet! Your neighbour is a national hero!

постоять.gloss: to stand for a while; to wait

examples.trans: I'll stand here for a bit.

meanings.note: + 3rd person verb: 'пусть строят' = let them build

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.

разбирать.gloss: to take apart; to take, grab (one each)

examples.text: Немедленно разбирай весь этот шкаф обратно!
examples.trans: Take this whole wardrobe apart again right now!

meanings.note: informal: a group of young men; ребята! = guys!

examples.trans: The boys will have a word with you.

examples.text: Тогда ребята с тобой поработают. До свидания, Аркадий Борисович.
examples.trans: Then the boys will have a little word with you. Goodbye, Arkady Borisovich.

meanings.note: Dining establishment. Borrowed from French 'restaurant' (from 'restaurer', to restore strength with rich broth); entered Russian in the early 19th century.

examples.trans: They called from the Italian restaurant.
In the evening they went to a restaurant.

examples.text: Кстати, звонили из итальянского ресторана. Дарят папе романтический ужин на двоих.
examples.trans: By the way, they called from the Italian restaurant. They're giving Dad a romantic dinner for two.

examples.text: Здесь рисовая бумага, съедобные краски и пищевой принтер.
examples.trans: Here is rice paper, edible paints, and a food printer.

examples.text: Значит, меню из рисовой бумаги мы отдаём гостю.
examples.trans: So, we give the rice-paper menu to the guest.

examples.text: Подождите, ребята, ведь это же рисовая бумага!
examples.trans: Wait, guys, this is edible rice paper after all!

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.
We will sit together in a friendly way at the table.

examples.text: Не бойся, всё в порядке! Посидим дружно за столом.
examples.trans: Don't be afraid, everything is fine! We will sit together in a friendly way at the table.
Take your feet off the table quickly!
The white one? Give me the keys.

meanings.note: At the start of a question.

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.
Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.

examples.text: Спасибо большое, это мой любимый художник.
examples.trans: Thank you very much, this is my favorite artist.

meanings.note: Часть сделки = part of the deal.

examples.trans: I kept my part of the deal.
This is the best part of the book.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, я выполнил свою часть сделки.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I kept my part of the deal.

meanings.note: the plural is a different word: люди, людям, о людях

examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.
I know the problems of ordinary people.

meanings.note: Informal. Borrowed from French 'chef' (head, leader, from Latin 'caput'); in Russian kitchen culture 'шеф' is the standard form of address for the executive head chef.

examples.trans: The chef is in the kitchen.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.note: alone: 'я этого не хочу' = I don't want that

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
